notes.title: Costume selection bug fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35456771/6ddedaa5b95df78be4293cef66fbfbc5ef58fba0.gif[/img]

There was an issue that caused the wrong costume to be selected. We made a patch and it should be fixed now.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Small bug fix when you selected "try again"
notes.content:
Quick question. Have you unlocked all costumes already?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35456771/d2c8f6bb9bfc52faac48ffd3f619f9b0a917bef3.jpg[/img]

And now, the reason for this post:

There was a small bug that happened sometimes when you selected "try again" after losing. The bug is now fixed. Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Color Slayer store page is up!
notes.content:
Hello all!

As you see, Color Slayer's store page is up. This game is very different to any other game we've developed in the past, and that makes it very special to us.

If you're into fast-paced color-based run-and-slash games (such a specific description!) , and wanna support us, please wishlist the game now!
